subject: Aligning senior leadership to unblock pilot: availability for leadership handshake + tech deep-dive
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@citozero.com>, Becky Li <becky.li@citozero.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning senior leadership to unblock pilot: availability for leadership handshake + tech deep-dive

Hi Amit & Becky —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps to keep momentum toward a pilot: 

- Key outcome from discovery: CitoZero wants to validate inference economics (latency & cost) for your real-world 8–12k QPS spikes and confirm private deployment options for regulated data.
- Next essential step: a short leadership handshake (VP / CTO) to align success metrics and procurement runway, followed immediately by a technical deep-dive (30–45m) with our solutions engineering team to lock the runbook and pilot gating criteria.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue 2028-06-27 10:00–11:00 (Leadership handshake, followed by 11:15–11:45 tech deep-dive)
- Wed 2028-06-28 15:00–16:00 (Leadership handshake, followed by 16:15–16:45 tech deep-dive)

Attaching a one-pager and a lightweight proposed agenda for the combined session. If those two windows don't work, share 2–3 windows that do and we will lock a slot.

Goals for the call:
- Confirm executive success criteria and pilot SLAs
- Validate technical runbook items (networking, KMS, logging, model variant selection)
- Agree on timeline and procurement touchpoints

Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf, pilot-proposed-agenda.docx

If agreeable, I can send a single calendar hold for 90 minutes that covers both the handshake and tech deep-dive back-to-back.

Thanks — looking forward to locking the slot.

— Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Amit Shah <amit@citozero.com>

Date: 2028-06-21T16:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning senior leadership to unblock pilot: availability for leadership handshake + tech deep-dive

Thanks Priyom — good summary.

Becky (our CTO) is looped here. We are excited to see cost/latency numbers with our real traffic patterns. For scheduling, Tue 6/27 morning is tight for Becky; Wed 6/28 at 15:00 PT looks best for both Becky and our Head of Infra (I'll add him if needed).

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can you include a brief note on expected data flows (ingest -> inference -> retention) and whether Redwood supports in-region VPC peering for private deployments?
2) Procurement wants an estimated cost ballpark for a 90-day pilot (even a range) so they can earmark budget. Not looking for a signed quote yet, just an order-of-magnitude.

If Wed 6/28 15:00 PT works, please send the invite and include procurement@citozero.com.

— Amit
Director of ML Platforms | CitoZero
amit@citozero.com

- Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-leadership-handshake
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (deal CZ-2028-091)
- Prep docs: redwood-onepager.pdf, pilot-proposed-agenda.docx, tech-runbook.pdf

1) Data flows: we'll share a 1-slide flow in the meeting and Marissa will walk through VPC/KMS options. Redwood supports in-region VPC peering and customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; we'll surface the network diagram during the deep-dive.
2) Cost ballpark for 90-day pilot: Karthik will provide a conservative range in the invite description, but order-of-magnitude: $40k–$90k depending on reserved capacity vs. burst and data egress assumptions. We'll follow up with a short capex/opex split after the call.

Attachments included on the invite. If anything changes on your side please reply and we'll re-align. Looking forward to it.
